text:
[Council File 26-1372; CD 4]
Motion (Raman – Blumenfield) relative to a transfer of Proposition K funds for a new data network to support the security system and building monitoring systems of the Studio City Recreation Center – Gymnasium project located at 12621 Rye Street.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion to transfer Proposition K funds for a new data network that will support the security and building monitoring systems at the Studio City Recreation Center gymnasium project.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Oct 21, 2026)
